summary: [[character:riker]] and [[character:homer]] covertly survey [[location:sol]] and find high radiation at several locations and [[location:earth]] looking badly damaged from afar. Brazilian probes strike their decoy near [[location:jupiter]] and its signal cuts off, revealing a larger force and an impending asteroid operation against Earth. Riker concludes the attackers are probably directed by Medeiros clones, but their identities and control remain uncertain.

updates.current_state: At [[location:sol]] with [[character:homer]], covertly surveying the system and investigating an impending asteroid operation against [[location:earth]].
At [[location:sol]] with [[character:riker]], covertly surveying the system and helping investigate an impending asteroid operation against [[location:earth]].

updates.state: High radiation has been detected at several locations, and long-range imagery looks bad. [[character:homer]] suspects nuclear detonations.

updates.description: A converted interplanetary freighter equipped as a [[technology:von-neumann-probe]]: a small, light, resilient design built to copy itself. It carries a [[technology:surge-drive]] ring, fusion reactor, ramscoop, three large [[technology:3d-printers]], [[technology:roamers]], [[technology:nanites]] and mining cargo carriers, but no weapons. Version-2 HEAVENs add a larger reactor and drive, better reactor shielding, a rail-gun, [[technology:ship-busters]], bigger replicant systems and more cargo room. Its communications report to [[location:earth]] and were not built for interstellar conversation.

A subspace detection technology enabled by the same breakthrough as the [[technology:surge-drive]]. It can monitor distance, scan for threats and detect dense objects within a light-hour. An emitter flaw can give a much weaker ping with poor close-range sensitivity, which [[character:bill]] suspects may reach farther. It gives little fine detail at long range.
